title.zh: Cobo Wallet宣布将于12月1日关闭服务，用户需提前转出资产
title.en: Cobo Wallet宣布将于12月1日关闭服务，用户需提前转出资产

current_state.zh:
Cobo Wallet 于 10 月 16 日发布公告称，其 App 服务将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日正式关闭。用户需在 11 月 30 日 23 时 59 分前完成全部资产转出，并更新此前在其他平台设置的 Cobo Wallet 收款地址。

仍在通过 Cobo Wallet App 存储或接收资产的用户面临硬性截止期限，公告称未能在 App 关闭前完成资产转出的，将视为用户已同意按月收取账户管理费的安排。

管理费按币本位计算，为账户剩余资产的 2%，每月最低收取等值 100 美元。公告未说明关闭服务的具体原因，也未披露 Cobo 旗下其他产品或机构业务是否受到影响。
current_state.en: Cobo Wallet announced its app service will shut down on December 1, 2026, requiring users to withdraw all assets and update associated receiving addresses and withdrawal whitelists by November 30, after which remaining balances incur a 2% monthly account management fee (minimum $100 equivalent) deemed accepted by users who fail to move funds.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Cobo Wallet announced its app service will shut down on December 1, 2026, requiring users to withdraw all assets and update associated receiving addresses and withdrawal whitelists by November 30, after which remaining balances incur a 2% monthly account management fee (minimum $100 equivalent) deemed accepted by users who fail to move funds.
updates.background_zh: 公告提示受影响用户尽快确认链上资产、收款地址以及关联平台的提币白名单设置；提币白名单机制指仅允许向用户事先添加并通过验证的地址提币。Cobo 提供钱包与托管类服务，公告在提及旗下其他产品和机构业务时，并未说明这些业务是否受到影响。
updates.background_en: The notice tells affected users to confirm their on-chain assets, receiving addresses and withdrawal whitelist settings on linked platforms — a whitelist restricts withdrawals to addresses a user has pre-approved. Cobo operates wallet and custody services, and the announcement refers to other Cobo products and institutional business without stating whether they are affected.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次关停把一款消费级钱包的剩余资产集中到一个截止时点：用户要么在 11 月 30 日前把资产转出 App，要么承担每月 2% 的账户管理费，这可能使该日期前后的链上提币流量与自托管钱包、其他平台的充值活动发生变化。相关影响仅限于公告所述的消费级 App 范围，公告未说明 Cobo 其他产品或机构托管业务是否涉及其中。
updates.market_impact_en: The wind-down concentrates a consumer wallet's residual balances into a single deadline: users are pushed to move assets off the App before November 30 or face a 2% monthly fee, which can shift on-chain withdrawal flows and deposit activity toward self-custody wallets or other platforms around that date. Any effect is limited to the consumer app segment described in the notice, which does not state whether Cobo's other products or institutional custody are involved.
